title: Build your career perspective
description: Check your understanding of AI skills and changing work. No job-risk predictions.

questions.question: What does a study of AI task exposure usually describe?
options: Potential effects on tasks under stated assumptions
questions.explanation: Exposure research estimates potential task effects. It does not directly predict an individual employment outcome.

questions.question: What is a useful way to assess your role?
options: Look only at the job title
Break the role into tasks and responsibilities
questions.explanation: Task-level analysis makes assistance opportunities and human responsibilities easier to understand.

questions.question: Which portfolio claim is most credible?
options: A documented project with inputs, checks, results, and limits
questions.explanation: Clear evidence and honest limitations are more informative than broad unsupported claims.

questions.question: Which learning priority is usually more transferable?
options: Learning task selection, evidence checking, and data boundaries
questions.explanation: Transferable methods remain useful as products and interfaces change.

questions.question: Can this quiz predict whether you will lose your job?
options: No, it samples knowledge and cannot predict employment
Yes, if you answer every question
Yes, because it includes a score
questions.explanation: Job outcomes depend on many contextual factors. This quiz does not assess or predict personal job security.

questions.question: What is a useful next step after noticing a skill gap?
options: Ignore it until a role changes
Choose a relevant small project and get feedback
questions.explanation: A focused project with feedback helps turn a learning need into observable practice.
